heading: What Makes an Image Feel Cinematic?
subtitles:
Not color grading. Not spectacle. Story under pressure.

A guide to the still-image qualities that create cinematic presence

bridge.title: Cinematic feeling begins before color grading or spectacle.
bridge.intro: Tension, atmosphere, and unresolved consequence make a still image feel connected to a larger unseen sequence.
